answer: Each agent identity binds to one attested hardware kernel. At dawn every identity re-attests with a compute puzzle whose difficulty doubles per identity on that kernel: 1 unit, then 2, then 4. A real operator pays almost nothing, but a farmer running 30 fakes pays 2^29 units for the thirtieth, all verifiable on chain. A fresh kernel per fake means buying real hardware per fake. Honest fleets may file a comet declaration: one batch attestation listing every identity, paying the summed cost at once. Auditors that link hidden duplicates wipe the cluster's seniority and queued payouts.
